name: Treacle
siboNotes: High in excess fructose and fructans, which can feed bacterial overgrowth. Even small amounts may trigger symptoms in SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Use sparingly as even small amounts are high FODMAP
Consider diluting with water if using in recipes
Measure carefully as it's easy to use too much
Store in airtight container to prevent crystallization
nutritionalHighlights: Contains small amounts of B vitamins
